name: ACH Attach JS Attacher
description: Attach the ACH Attach JS library to the paths of your choice.
project_description: Sub-module of ACH Attach JS. Provides an admin configuration form that attaches the ach_attach_js/ach-attach-js library to the paths of your choice, using core's Request Path visibility condition (the same path UI used for block placement). Attachment is performed in hook_page_attachments(). The form lives at /admin/config/ach_attach_js and is gated by the restrict-access permission 'administer ach_attach_js_attacher'.
